mcqs.q: In some areas, the case-fatality rate of brown dog tick-associated RMSF reaches up to:
mcqs.e: The abstract states the case-fatality rate is up to 50% in some communities.

mcqs.q: The conceptual framework for RMSF prevention is built around which approach?
mcqs.e: The authors use a One Health approach with interdisciplinary teams to identify at-risk communities.

mcqs.q: Which community feature is identified as a driver of RMSF emergence and endemicity?
mcqs.e: Risk includes large free-roaming dog populations, brown dog ticks, limited resources, and low provider awareness.

mcqs.q: By xenodiagnosis, what proportion of sampled dogs were infectious to sand flies?
mcqs.e: 9 of 73 dogs (12%) were infectious to P. argentipes during winter and rainy seasons.

mcqs.q: What remains the primary source of L. donovani transmission according to the study?
mcqs.e: Human VL patients remain primary transmission sources, though canine infection may contribute to human exposure.

mcqs.q: L. donovani is transmitted by which vector?
mcqs.e: Transmission occurs via the sand fly Phlebotomus argentipes.

mcqs.q: The operational tool concluded that overall L. infantum introduction risk via imported dogs could be:
mcqs.e: Risk varies but could be high without proper controls.

mcqs.q: Which is NOT among the recommended dog risk-management strategies?
mcqs.e: Recommended strategies were insecticides/repellents, sterilization, and treatment, not euthanasia.

mcqs.q: Students concurrently enrolled in DVM and MPH programs reported significantly higher self-rated knowledge in:
o: Disease measurement, ethical/legal principles, and epidemiologic data interpretation
mcqs.e: Dual-degree students showed significantly higher self-reported knowledge in these public health domains.

mcqs.q: By coursework completion, students' most valued competencies were related to:
mcqs.e: The most valued competencies were epidemiology, biostatistics, and behavioral health.

mcqs.q: Which students demonstrated significantly higher program satisfaction?
o: Those with veterinary and animal science backgrounds
Students intending to leave the field
mcqs.e: Students with veterinary/animal science backgrounds reported significantly higher satisfaction.

mcqs.q: Compared with classic classroom PBL, field simulation PBL produced:
mcqs.e: Mean satisfaction was significantly higher with field simulation than classic PBL.

mcqs.q: How did cognitive-domain attainment compare between the two PBL groups?
mcqs.e: Cognitive domain attainment was comparable between the two PBL settings.

mcqs.q: The study's overall conclusion regarding field simulation was that it:
o: Enhanced positive learning experiences and attitudes
mcqs.e: Field simulation enhanced positive learning experiences and better attitudes toward learning.

mcqs.q: Compared with non-owners, pet owners on Staten Island were:
o: Less likely to have found a tick (46% vs 63%)
More likely to have found a tick (63% vs 46%)
Equally likely to have found a tick
mcqs.e: Pet owners reported finding ticks more often (63%) than non-owners (46%).

mcqs.q: Among pet owners, who were most likely to find ticks on their pets?
o: Dog owners (dog-only or dog and cat)
mcqs.e: Dog owners were more likely than cat-only owners to have found ticks on their pets.

mcqs.q: Regarding knowledge that ticks transmit Lyme disease, pet owners were:
o: More likely to know than non-owners
Less likely to know than non-owners
mcqs.e: Pet owners were more likely to know ticks transmit Lyme disease.

journal: Journal of Feline Medicine and Surgery

mcqs.q: Which clinical sign was universally present in cats with discospondylitis?
mcqs.e: All cats presented with spinal hyperaesthesia.

mcqs.q: Which antibiotics were recommended as reasonable first-line choices?
mcqs.e: Amoxicillin-clavulanic acid or cephalosporins were suggested as first-line antibiotics.

mcqs.q: With sustained antibiotic therapy (median ~3 months), the prognosis was:
mcqs.e: Prognosis was favourable, with no long-term recurrence on sustained therapy.

mcqs.q: Which surgical technique was used to correct feline eyelid agenesis?
o: Lip commissure to eyelid transposition flap
mcqs.e: The lip commissure to eyelid transposition (LCET) flap was used.

mcqs.q: The most common postoperative complication observed was:
mcqs.e: Partial flap necrosis occurred in four of the corrected eyelids.

mcqs.q: The case series concluded the technique is suitable when:
o: Referral to a specialist is not an option due to limited resources
mcqs.e: It is presented as suitable where specialist referral is unavailable, as in shelters/low-cost clinics.

journal: Veterinary Clinics of North America: Small Animal Practice

mcqs.q: Preliminary evidence shows specific probiotics are beneficial in dogs with:
o: Parvovirus infection and acute hemorrhagic diarrhea syndrome
mcqs.e: Benefit was suggested in canine parvovirus and acute hemorrhagic diarrhea syndrome.

mcqs.q: In dogs with inflammatory bowel disease, specific probiotics were noted to:
mcqs.e: IBD-specific probiotics can decrease clinical severity in dogs.

mcqs.q: The review's overall assessment of small-animal probiotic/synbiotic products was that they:
o: Often do not fulfill the criteria to qualify as a probiotic
mcqs.e: Many products do not meet probiotic criteria and lack mode-of-action studies.

mcqs.q: What was the prevalence of positive cultures among feline cystocentesis urine samples?
mcqs.e: 425 of 2712 samples (15.7%) had a positive culture.

mcqs.q: Which was the most commonly isolated bacterium?
mcqs.e: E. coli accounted for 43.7% of isolates.

mcqs.q: Enterococcus species most commonly showed resistance to:
mcqs.e: Enterococcus showed 94.3% resistance to trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole.

mcqs.q: Did cutaneous infrared temperatures agree with rectal temperature in cats?
o: No, they were not in agreement
mcqs.e: Infrared cutaneous readings were not in agreement with rectal temperature.

mcqs.q: How did the three infrared thermometers compare with each other?
o: Not in good agreement among themselves
mcqs.e: The devices were also not in good agreement with one another.

mcqs.q: The study's conclusion regarding infrared thermometry in cats was that it:
o: Cannot reliably replace rectal temperature measurement
mcqs.e: Infrared gave no reproducible/constant data, so it cannot justify replacing rectal measurement.

journal: Journal of Feline Medicine and Surgery

mcqs.q: How did resolution of allergic reaction signs compare between diphenhydramine alone vs diphenhydramine plus glucocorticoid?
mcqs.e: There was no difference in resolution of clinical signs between the two groups.

mcqs.q: How many cats progressed to anaphylaxis in this study?
mcqs.e: No cat in either group progressed to anaphylaxis.

mcqs.q: Based on available human and veterinary literature, the authors concluded glucocorticoids for acute allergic reactions are:
mcqs.e: Glucocorticoids are not indicated to treat acute allergic reactions.
